items.summary_en: Argentine singer Tini announced her engagement to World Cup winner Rodrigo de Paul. She shared a video of her trip to Paris for her first dress trials and other preparations. The couple is very famous in Argentina.

items.raw_excerpt: Christchurch's Willowbank Wildlife Reserve is sounding the alarm over a planned housing development next door, saying it could threaten the park's future.

items.raw_excerpt: Dr. Raj Panjabi founded Last Mile Health to bring healthcare to people living in remote areas. The group is the 2026 recipient of the Conrad N. Hilton Humanitarian Prize.
items.summary_en: Dr. Raj Panjabi started Last Mile Health using money his wedding guests gave him. The group brings health care to people in faraway villages in Liberia. Last Mile Health just won the 2026 Hilton Humanitarian Prize of $3 million.

items.raw_excerpt: Only one in $9 of government roading funds gets spent in the South Island, a new report obtained by RNZ reveals.
